# proteingym

Source: [ProteinGym](https://github.com/OATML-Markslab/ProteinGym).

Role: reference-data.

The reference_files/DMS_substitutions.csv sequence mapping is used by scripts/prepare_gfp_aav_kermut_resources.py. Exact prepared GFP/AAV resources are supplied in the companion artifact bundle.

Pinned commit: `144fe22b07dfaeec2b366f2346203a9838a55b4c`. To inspect this exact version inside this folder:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/OATML-Markslab/ProteinGym.git external/proteingym/source
git -C external/proteingym/source checkout --detach 144fe22b07dfaeec2b366f2346203a9838a55b4c
```

The source checkout is optional and ignored by Git. See the upstream LICENSE and notices at the pinned revision before redistributing source. This folder documents provenance; it does not replace upstream attribution.
